title: 第179章 十二属相一第178章 百里坟二
content_zh:
“算上你们说的羊头跟猪头，这几个都属于十二属相，以龙为首也不是不可能。”
安衍继续道：“至于是真龙还是假龙，尚未可知。”
沈二心中有种莫名的直觉，那“龙头”十有八九是条假龙。
现在还不知对方抓他们来的目的，只能先老老实实待着，静观其变。
“哈欠——”
沈二又打了个喷嚏。
安衍往她身边靠，脱下外袍给她披上。
萧武忍不住调侃，“都快春日了还这么畏寒，你这身子骨是怎么打进比试十强的？”
“哈欠——”
沈二吸了吸鼻子，“什么十强？”
“你不知道？”萧武来了兴致，“当时与裴师兄那场你跑了，原本以为你的名次会定在第十六，结果你猜怎么着？长老会商议之后，直接把你定在第十位。”
“还有这回事？”沈二摸摸下巴，“怎么没听师父提起过？”
裴易笑出声，“当时你那些‘手下败将’都快把齐初长老的后山掀了，长老许是不愿提起。”
沈二可以想象那画面是何等壮观。
“你在天玄宗可是出了名，无人不知无人不晓，”萧武比划一下，“听说你入门不久，有机会我们比试比试。”
沈二没有拒绝，“会有机会的。”
眼前这两位都是四阶修为，齐仓也是四阶，而她的修为停滞在三阶已经有一段时间，若是在宗门大比遇上，肯定会吃亏。
得努努力，尽快提升修为才行。
这边。
天蒙蒙亮。

“小二！小二——！！”
“小二！安兄！”
“小二！！！”
叫喊声惊起大片鸟兽。
虞繁花双手叉腰，哑着嗓子道：“咳咳……他们两个到底跑哪去了？”
“迷踪林地势复杂，处处暗藏着危险。”韩执旭有些担忧，“就怕他们已遭遇不测。”
“有可能是他们俩私奔了。”百里识越道。
韩执旭：“嗯？”
“不可能。”虞繁花反驳道：“小二缺根筋，不可能不声不响的跟安先知私奔，极有可能是安先知那个混蛋哄骗小二。”
韩执旭：“啊？”
百里识越也是深受其害，“你别说，这种事情，安先知还真干得出来。”
“哈欠——”安衍皱眉，蹭了蹭鼻子。
沈二把外袍还给他，“穿上，别着凉了。”
“唉，我的灵力在恢复！”萧武惊道。不单是他，所有人都有这种感觉。
身子在慢慢回暖，五感也愈加敏锐，沈二抬头望向牢房外，“有人过来了。”
确切的说不是人，白茫茫的气雾蔓延至牢房门前，一个头生鹿角的身影在白雾中若隐若现。
“桀桀桀桀。”马头从雾中走出，生在脑袋两侧的眼睛弯成月牙，“天亮了，我们一起快乐玩耍吧。”
content_en:
"Including the sheep's head and pig's head you mentioned, these all belong to the twelve zodiac signs, and it is not impossible to have the dragon as the head."
An Yan continued: "As for whether it is a real dragon or a fake dragon, we still don't know."
Shen Er had an inexplicable intuition in his heart that the "dragon head" was most likely a fake dragon.
We still don't know the purpose of catching them, so we can only wait and see what happens.
"Yawn——"
Shen Er sneezed again.
Anyan leaned close to her, took off his robe and put it on her.
Xiao Wu couldn't help but tease, "It's almost spring and you're still so afraid of the cold. How did you get into the top ten in the competition with your body like this?"
"Yawn——"
Shen Er sniffed, "What are the top ten?"
"You don't know?" Xiao Wu became interested, "You ran away from the match with Senior Brother Pei. I originally thought that your ranking would be sixteenth, but guess what? After discussion, the Elder Council directly ranked you at tenth."
"Is there such a thing?" Shen Er touched his chin, "Why haven't you heard Master mention it?"
Pei Yi laughed out loud, "At that time, your 'defeated generals' almost overthrew Elder Qi Chu, and Elder Xu didn't want to mention it."
Shen Er could imagine how spectacular that scene was.
"You are well-known in Tianxuan Sect, everyone knows about it," Xiao Wu gestured, "I heard that you have just started, so if we have a chance, let's compete."
Shen Er did not refuse, "There will be a chance."
The two people in front of them are both at the fourth level of cultivation, Qi Cang is also at the fourth level, and her cultivation has been stagnant at the third level for a while. If they meet in the sect competition, she will definitely suffer.
You have to work hard and improve your cultivation as soon as possible.
This way.
The sky is bright.
"Xiao Er! Xiao Er——!!"
"Xiaoer! Brother An!"
"Second boy!!!"
The shouts startled a large number of birds and beasts.
Yu Fanhua put her hands on her hips and said in a hoarse voice: "Ahem...where did the two of them go?"
"The terrain of the Lost Forest is complicated, and there are dangers hidden everywhere." Han Zhixu was a little worried, "I am afraid that something unexpected has happened to them."
"It's possible that the two of them eloped." Baili Shiyue said.
Han Zhixu: "Huh?"
"Impossible." Yu Fanhua retorted: "The waiter is too weak to run away with An Xianzhi quietly. It is most likely that the bastard An Xianzhe deceived the waiter."
Han Zhixu: "Huh?"
Baili Shiyue was also deeply affected by this, "Don't tell me, Prophet An can really do this kind of thing."
"Yawn-" An Yan frowned and rubbed his nose.
Shen Er returned the robe to him, "Put it on, don't catch a cold."
"Oh, my spiritual power is recovering!" Xiao Wu said in shock. Not just him, everyone feels this way.
His body was slowly getting warmer and his senses were becoming more acute. Shen Er raised his head and looked outside the cell, "Someone is coming."
To be precise, it was not a human being. The white mist spread to the door of the cell, and a figure with antlers looming in the white mist.
"Jiejiejiejie." The horse's head walked out of the fog, its eyes on both sides of its head curved into crescents, "It's dawn, let's have fun together."
